heading.medium: Detailed Overview of Our Premium EV Charger

sentence.medium: Our EV charger is designed for both residential and commercial use.

accordion.paragraph-medium: The EV charger measures 24 inches in height, 12 inches in width, and 8 inches in depth, making it compact and space-efficient.
Available in sleek black or white finishes to complement any environment, from homes to commercial spaces.
Crafted from durable, weather-resistant materials ensuring longevity and reliability in various conditions.
Supports both AC and DC fast charging, catering to a wide range of electric vehicles with varying requirements.
Requires a standard electrical outlet and minimal setup, making installation straightforward for both residential and commercial sites.
